ratings.name: Hevy
limitations: Light theme only in selected media
No keyboard, running timer or history-detail screen
adopt: Grey prior value aligned beside bold current value per set, same unit order
Actual-load (heaviest weight) chart with dated axes
avoid: Volume/time/sets summary strip competing with logging
PR badge, One Rep Max metric, exercise illustrations

ratings.name: Strong
limitations: Dense rows; real target size unverified
adopt: Done/pending/active row states distinguished by boxes, checks and caret, not colour alone
Inline rest indicator right after the completed set
Light theme: neutral near-white surfaces with accent reserved for state
avoid: Est. 1RM charts
Small table-cell inputs for one-handed gym use
Health Connect/dashboard profile

ratings.name: Fitbod
limitations: No completion control visible in set entry
Progress shows derived strength scores, not logged loads
adopt: Current set labelled and outlined; completed tinted; upcoming subdued
avoid: Strength scores and generated plans
Media hero pushing sets down
Italic display numerals for data

ratings.name: Boostcamp
limitations: Toolbar time not proven to be rest countdown
RPE grid is not an optional-RIR flow
Depicted OS unknown; dark only in selected media
adopt: Charcoal + yellow/amber cohesion validates Rebuild dark direction
Verbal anchors if an optional RIR picker is ever added
Labelled secondary actions (Add Set, Swap) with icons
avoid: Five-column density with tiny effort superscripts
Accent colour on non-actionable exercise titles
% of 1RM targets, volume/bodyweight charts

ratings.name: Alpha Progression
limitations: No keyboard, expanded timer or light theme
adopt: Compact aligned prior-session mini-table beneath the logger
avoid: 10RM and automatic progression
Cryptic wrench/pencil header icons
Unlabelled thumbnail-only exercise navigation

ratings.name: Liftin'
limitations: Timer and Add callouts enlarged outside UI
adopt: Rest shown as elapsed/remaining against target (e.g. 0:30 / 1:30)
avoid: PR cards and calendar-as-motivation
Pure black surfaces and illustration-heavy rows
Ambiguous rep-circle tap target

ratings.name: Rebuild 0.1.3 baseline
limitations: Single scroll position; logged-set list below fold
Contrast values are token arithmetic, not pixel measurement
adopt: Preserve: dark charcoal/amber tokens, single full-width filled primary, large labelled kg/Reps/RIR fields, docked rest bar with +time/skip, exercise chips with n/N counters, prefilled-honesty copy, read-first history with per-set edit
avoid: Prose 'Last comparable' line that must be parsed
Text buttons inset from content edge
Seven amber text actions on history detail
Rest bar covering Log set at 200% in captured position
Olive-brown filled blocks on beige in light theme

rebuild_dark: Preserve palette (#171410 surface, #E6C27A primary; primary/surface 10.8:1, onPrimary/primary 7.7:1). Change only layout/emphasis: fewer amber text actions, aligned text buttons.
rebuild_light: Redirect, do not remove: near-neutral faintly warm surfaces (~#FAF9F7 / containers ~#F3F1EE), charcoal-ink filled primary (~#2E2924, cream label #F6E3BE), amber #E6C27A only as fill behind dark ink (never text/lone boundary on light, 1.6:1), text buttons in ink or deeper bronze (~#6B4E0E, 7.3:1). Illustrative values; verify all role pairs.
top_changes: Replace prose 'Last comparable' with per-set aligned rows adjacent to entry, emphasising row matching 'Log set N' (check 0/1/2 prior sets, lat-pulldown replacement, 200%, TalkBack)
Redirect light palette per rebuild_light; leave dark untouched (contrast test all used role pairs, system theme switching, no forced dark)
Reserve docked rest-bar height in scroll padding so it never covers Log set; optional remaining/target display (check 200%, IME open, landscape, process death)
Move working-set list (done/current/upcoming, non-colour state cues) directly after Log set (check edit-in-place, warm-up exclusion, recovery)
Reduce accent noise: align text buttons to content edge; group History detail 'Add missed set'/'Add exercise note' under per-exercise overflow (check reachability, labels, 48dp, semantics tests)
uncertainties: References are marketing composites; states/positions may be staged
Strong action_clarity 4 depends partly on composite keypad context
Charcoal light primary may feel stark; cleaner bronze is a valid alternative
Moving set list up may lengthen A71 scroll
RB judged on richer native evidence than references; possible scoring asymmetry
No interaction, touch-target, keyboard or dynamic-text verification for references
